answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable copper-weight deposit that scales with the number of identities sharing the same hardware enclave: one identity per crystal-clear attested enclave, and any extra identity in the same grove pays an exponentially larger deposit. An attacker minting ten thousand fake identities must lock real capital plus provision unique hardware for each, so a sybil flood costs more than any plausible gain, while honest agents with one real identity pay almost nothing.
